decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ASH-EX-2B, dated 28/01/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-EX-3B, dated 28/01/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-EX-4B, dated 28/01/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-PR-1B, dated 03/05/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-PR-2B, dated 03/05/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-PR-3B, dated 03/05/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-PR-6B, dated 03/05/13, received 07/05/13; ASH-PR-7B, dated 03/05/13, received 07/05/13; and Design and Access Statement, dated 11/04/13, received 18/04/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 9 Ashley Drive, Isleworth, TW7 5QA.
description: Erection of a two storey side and part rear extension and single storey rear extension to the house
